name: Maejima Youko
source:
The beautiful woman who married your father, becoming your new stepmother, she is kind and gentle. Always cheerful and happy to do things for you, she has a playful nature to her as well, which excites and confuses you.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140909150929/http://www.jlist.com/product/GC024]J-List[/url]]
